novel_features.name: Revision drift check
novel_features.description: See which downloaded spec sheets and manuals have a newer revision available upstream, so project shares never run stale docs.
novel_features.rationale: Only a local catalog with revision metadata can diff your downloaded filenames against the live Rev column without re-downloading everything.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use this before commissioning or re-quoting to catch docs superseded since the last sync.

novel_features.name: Doc-set completeness
novel_features.description: Per-model gap report across Brochure, Declaration of Conformity, Design Guide, Product Guide, Manual, and Revit BIM — see which doc types each model is missing.
novel_features.rationale: Requires cross-tabbing the six literature categories per model in the local catalog — no single site page provides this view.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it before a bid submittal or commissioning checklist to catch missing compliance or reference docs.

novel_features.name: Library what's-new
novel_features.description: Newest Extron literature across the whole library, ordered by date, filterable by category and age.
novel_features.rationale: The site only surfaces the Date column inside letter-scoped tables; a synced catalog makes the whole library sortable by date offline.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to track manual/firmware-doc releases without re-checking the website.

novel_features.name: BOM doc bundle
novel_features.description: Assemble the full official doc set for every model in a rack bill of materials — report or batch-download in one pass.
novel_features.rationale: Resolves model numbers through the local catalog and orchestrates per-model doc bundles; no website flow does this.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it when a project's doc binder must match the exact gear list on the job.

novel_features.name: Series grouping
novel_features.description: Browse every document for a product family (DTP, MAV, IPL, DVS, ...) across all alphabetical letters at once.
novel_features.rationale: The site indexes literature only by first letter, so family browsing across letters is impossible there; local prefix grouping fixes it.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to pull every doc for a family before writing control code or a design guide review.

novel_features.name: Download integrity
novel_features.description: Compare local PDF sizes against the download ledger to flag truncated or mismatched downloads.
novel_features.rationale: Downloads are the flaky leg of the pipeline (WAF resets); only local-vs-ledger byte comparison can prove integrity.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it after a batch download or sync to confirm every PDF landed complete and current.

narrative.headline: Every Extron spec sheet and user manual, browsable and searchable offline with revision tracking no other Extron tool has.
narrative.value_prop: Extron publishes spec sheets and manuals at extron.com, but finding them means browser tabs, letter-scoped tables, and a WAF that blocks plain curl. extron-pp-cli syncs the whole literature catalog into a local database, then lets you list, search, download, and track revisions from the terminal — including what's new (literature recent), which downloaded docs went stale (literature updates), and which doc types a rack's models are missing (catalog completeness).

quickstart.comment: Health check that works without credentials — confirms the CLI and its config are sane.
Fetch the Extron literature catalog into the local store — everything else reads it.
Browse the Manual category for M products (Matrix, MAV) straight from the official index.
Resolve a product name to its official documents with revision and date metadata.
Search the synced catalog offline — no website, no WAF.

troubleshoots.symptom: Connection reset / read tcp ... connection reset by peer on sync or list
troubleshoots.fix: Extron's WAF intermittently resets non-browser connections. Re-run the command — retries succeed. The CLI retries once automatically.

troubleshoots.symptom: search returns nothing right after install
troubleshoots.fix: Run `extron-pp-cli sync` first — search reads the local catalog, which starts empty.

troubleshoots.symptom: literature updates shows everything as stale
troubleshoots.fix: The drift check compares local filenames against the catalog; re-download with `extron-pp-cli literature updates --download` to normalize filenames.

narrative.when_to_use: Use extron-pp-cli whenever an agent or integrator needs Extron spec sheets, user manuals, design/product guides, Declarations of Conformity, or Revit BIM families for a project — browsing the official literature library, checking what changed, assembling doc sets for a rack, or verifying downloaded PDFs are current and complete.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI to control or configure Extron AV devices (SIS/TCP, SSH, IP Link web interfaces) — this CLI covers literature only.
Do not use this CLI for Extron firmware files or software downloads — the literature library does not include them.
Do not use this CLI for non-Extron documentation or generic AV manuals.
